items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: I know Blue, well I didn't know him good, but I've been behind his music.

ctx.x: You remember another cornet player, Bunk Johnson? No. What's that called Bunk?
I know Blue, well I didn't know him good, but I've been behind his music. He's a fella who broke his gall string right down my way, one son behind a parade.
